name: Dusk Rats in the Deep Tunnels

text.offer: Widow Qesino says, "There are worse things than rats under Jasper, dear. Dusk rats, the sewer men call them: black as pitch and fast as a knife, deep in the tunnels. One killed a sewer man last week. Kill ten of them."
text.progress: Widow Qesino says, "The dusk rats haunt the deepest tunnels of the Sewers of Jasper. Bring light."
text.complete: Widow Qesino says, "Ten. The sewer men will thank you, and so do I."

steps.objective: Dusk rats slain in the Sewers of Jasper
